# Master Glass Solutions

> Commercial and residential glass installation, fabrication, repair, and custom glass services in Boerne and San Antonio, Texas.

## About

Master Glass Solutions is a glass contractor based in San Antonio, TX, serving Boerne, San Antonio, Cordillera Ranch, Fair Oaks Ranch, The Dominion, and Alamo Heights. 20+ years of experience in commercial and residential glass. 24/7 emergency glass support available. Learn more on the [About page](https://www.mgsusa.llc/about).

## Services

- [Residential Glass](https://www.mgsusa.llc/residential-glass) — Shower enclosures, mirrors, window glass replacement, custom glass for homes
- [Commercial Glass](https://www.mgsusa.llc/commercial-glass) — Storefronts, partitions, repair, and project-specific glass work for businesses
- [Emergency Glass Repair](https://www.mgsusa.llc/emergency-glass-repair) — 24/7 support for urgent broken glass situations
- [Storefront Glass](https://www.mgsusa.llc/storefront-glass) — Customer-facing glass systems for retail and commercial properties
- [Custom Glass](https://www.mgsusa.llc/custom-glass) — Purpose-built solutions for non-standard openings and design requirements
- [Shower Enclosures](https://www.mgsusa.llc/shower-enclosures) — Frameless and custom shower glass installations
- [Mirrors](https://www.mgsusa.llc/mirrors) — Custom-cut mirrors for residential and commercial spaces
- [Window Glass Replacement](https://www.mgsusa.llc/window-glass-replacement) — Replacement glass for existing residential window openings

## How to Get a Quote

Call 210-370-3700 or visit the [Request a Quote](https://www.mgsusa.llc/request-quote) page. Provide: property address, service type, photos/rough dimensions, desired timing, and best contact info.

## Emergency Glass

For broken glass affecting safety, security, or weather protection, call 210-370-3700 immediately. Do not wait for a web form response. For life-safety emergencies, call 911 first. See the [Emergency Glass Repair](https://www.mgsusa.llc/emergency-glass-repair) page for details.
